notes: Trilingual protected-monument board (Tigrinya, Amharic, English). lines.latin: Nure teqolto yetefech'e (Nure roasted and ground)

notes: Hand-painted wall sign for the Nure coffee distributor (Harar). Target is the large red Amharic text plus the English line on the painted coffee bag. Not transcribed: the small Amharic line above the English (repeats lines 1-2) and the small slogan below it (first-grade quality). Peeling paint at right. Flickr title 'Prime Harar Coffee'.

author: Adam Jones from Kelowna, BC, Canada

Unmodified original.
notes: Large billboard in Axum. Only the two name lines are transcribed; the smaller Amharic list of services (meetings, graduation, internet cafe, weddings), the language strip (Amharic/Tigrigna/English/Indian) and 'Tel:-0348750034' are not. First glyph read as ስ (not ሲ).

author: Rod Waddington
attribution: Photo: Rod Waddington, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/64607715@N05/10883046724. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Painted facade lettering on a bar in Jinka: Amharic on the red panel, Latin on the yellow beam below (paint peeling around 'Ni'). The HAIG whisky bottle mural is a distractor.

author: Rod Waddington
attribution: Photo: Rod Waddington, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/64607715@N05/12925409354. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Ethiopic-only hotel sign (no Latin), so 'negative'. Target is the row of yellow 3-D letters on a rooftop frame, seen from below against sky; second row gives the town (Bale Goba). The weathered painted panel above repeats 'ይልማ' / 'አምሣ' with a stylised cursive 'ሆቴል' (not transcribed as separate lines). Least certain glyph: the third letter of the second word, read as ሣ (three-pronged ሠ form with long right leg), not ሳ/ሻ; checker please confirm.

author: Rod Waddington
attribution: Photo: Rod Waddington, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/64607715@N05/15895784975. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted music-shop board, frontal and sharp: Afaan Oromo 'Mana Muuziqaa Raastaa' (Rasta music house) in red, Amharic equivalent in blue. Painted guitarist and drawings of a watch, phone and stereo are illustrations, not a real person. A tiny unreadable label under the stereo drawing is ignored.

author: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive
attribution: Photo: Adam Jones, Ph.D. - Global Photo Archive, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Flickr. Source: https://www.flickr.com/photos/41000732@N04/8699558802. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Large printed banner in Axum with a Seattle skyline. First Ethiopic word is spelled with ስ (sɨ), not the usual ሲ, as painted. Not transcribed: a small yellow word under 'ለሰርግ' and the bottom language strip (Amharic/Tigrinya/English/Indian in both scripts, partly behind poles) and a 'Yoni Advert' tag at bottom right. People in the foreground are incidental.
